statement:
∀ (f : ℝ → ℂ),
  Integrable f volume →
    ∀ (v : ℝ),
      ContinuousAt f v →
        Tendsto
          (fun c => ∫ (w : ℝ), ((↑π * ↑c) ^ (↑(Module.finrank ℝ ℝ) / 2) * cexp (-↑π ^ 2 * ↑c * ↑‖v - w‖ ^ 2)) • f w)
          atTop (𝓝 (f v))

goal.text:
Tendsto (fun c => ∫ (w : ℝ), ((↑π * ↑c) ^ (↑(Module.finrank ℝ ℝ) / 2) * cexp (-↑π ^ 2 * ↑c * ↑‖v - w‖ ^ 2)) • f w) atTop
  (𝓝 (f v))
